verdict.rationale: Vast.ai documents scoped API keys with limited permissions for CI/CD and shared tooling (vast-ai-docs-5, vast-ai-docs-19, vast-ai-docs-24), which addresses credential scoping. However, there is no evidence of team/multi-user management, role-based access control (RBAC), or per-member spend controls — the docs only describe a single-account API key scoping model. missing for 10: team member invitations, role definitions (admin/member/viewer), per-user spend limits or budget controls, audit logs of key usage, and independent confirmation that scoped keys enforce permissions in practice.
